title: artifact_emit meta: chart
description: meta for artifact type 'chart'. path: project-relative JSON file holding a Plotly spec ({data:[...],layout:{...}}) or a bare traces array.

panel_id.description: Stable panel id; re-emitting with the same panel_id updates the panel in place and `close` with it removes it. Defaults to a hash of (type, path).

chart_type.description: Chart subtype hint, e.g. bar, line, scatter, pie.
